name: Booster Club Foods/eOrganic Products
tagline: Booster Club Foods/eOrganic Products, Frisco, TX: CSA meat farm
description: Booster Club Foods/eOrganic Products is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 2591 Dallas Parkway #103, TX. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
